title: Plan customer DR pilot (2 design partners) for Private backup/restore toolkit
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Goal
Plan and execute a structured pilot of the Private backup/restore + DR toolkit with two design partners. This ticket covers: environment prerequisites, a proposed schedule/run-of-show, roles/coverage, and the feedback capture template.

Pilot candidates (proposed)
1) Helix Financial Software (VPC / Kubernetes) – primary goal: validate S3+KMS wiring, scheduled backups, and in-place restore within a defined maintenance window.
2) Northbridge Health Systems (on-prem / restricted / partial air-gap) – primary goal: validate staging repo flow, offline bundle restore, and key-handling expectations.

Outcomes we need from the pilot
- Confirm end-to-end operator flow works with minimal Redwood involvement (target: <30 min of Redwood guidance during live run, excluding kickoff).
- Validate runbooks are sufficient and match real-world permissions/network constraints.
- Collect concrete deltas (docs gaps, defaults, preflight checks, alert thresholds) with owners and dates.

Environment prerequisites checklist (send to customer at least 7 days prior)
A) Cluster + access
- Kubernetes cluster meets Redwood Private minimums (version supported by current installer); nodes sized per Private control plane requirements.
- Operator has cluster-admin or equivalent for the restore window (or pre-approved break-glass role with audit).
- Ability to run one-off Jobs/CronJobs in the Redwood namespace (for backup and restore jobs).
- Exec/log access: kubectl logs for backup/restore jobs; access to Postgres logs if external.

B) Storage target prerequisites
- VPC pilot (preferred): S3 bucket in same region + VPC endpoint / gateway configured.
  - Bucket policy permits list/get/put/delete for the backup prefix.
  - KMS key configured for SSE-KMS (customer-owned CMK). Confirm key policy allows encryption/decryption for the backup role.
- On-prem pilot: staging repository available as NFS or S3-compatible (minio) endpoint reachable from cluster.
  - If offline bundle flow: agreed max bundle size per upload and process for transporting bundle between networks (USB / secure transfer) and where it will be mounted.

C) Identity / credentials
- Dedicated IAM role (or workload identity) for backups with least privilege (no wildcard actions, scope limited to backup bucket/prefix + KMS key).
- Confirm no plaintext keys are shared with Redwood; Redwood can review policies/screenshots but should not receive secret material.

D) Networking
- No outbound internet required for tooling flows; confirm any internal proxies and allowed egress destinations.
- If using S3 VPC endpoint: verify DNS resolution from cluster nodes and that the endpoint policy does not block required calls.

E) Operational readiness
- Maintenance window agreed (start/end times) and a named operator accountable for go/no-go.
- Confirm baseline backup frequency/retention so pilot does not disrupt existing customer policies.
- Agree evidence artifacts to capture (timestamps, command outputs, restore validation results) for customer compliance needs.

Proposed pilot schedule (per customer)
T-10 to T-7 days: Readiness + prerequisites
- 45-min kickoff: confirm goals, topology, storage target, and key-handling expectations.
- Redwood provides: prereq checklist + runbooks + “known gotchas” list.
- Customer provides: IAM/KMS (or on-prem staging) details and confirms maintenance window.

T-5 days: Dry-run (no restore)
- Run `rw-private-dr backup create` in a test namespace or against a non-prod cluster (preferred) OR production during low-traffic window.
- Run `rw-private-dr backup verify` and confirm checksums/encryption metadata.
- Confirm backup observability: dashboard shows last success; alerting is quiet.

T-0 day: Restore drill (primary event)
Option A (VPC): in-place restore
- Enable maintenance mode, take fresh backup, execute restore plan, restore DB + artifacts, run validation gates + smoke tests, disable maintenance mode.
- Capture total RTO and “hands-on keyboard” time.

Option B (on-prem): restore to new cluster or offline bundle restore
- Restore control plane first, validate API reachability, confirm key access, then proceed to artifact restore and smoke tests.

T+2 business days: Retro + follow-ups
- 30-min retro with customer operator + Redwood (SE + SRE + Eng Private as needed).
- Produce a short summary: what worked, what was confusing, what should be automated.
- File issues/PRs and update runbooks; agree if/when to repeat drill.

Roles and coverage (internal)
- Primary SE lead: Markus Klein (coordination, customer comms, run-of-show)
- SRE coverage: Rafael Mendes (restore drill facilitation, evidence expectations, alerting validation)
- Security consult: Marcus Lin / Hanae Suzuki (key-handling questions, break-glass role audit requirements)
- Eng Private escalation: Ethan Park (control plane hooks / maintenance mode) + Michael Nguyen (DB/PITR questions)

Feedback capture template
Use the shared template and ensure we capture both quantitative + qualitative:
- Quantitative: time to complete backup, verify, restore; number of manual steps; number of retries; size of artifacts; API smoke test pass/fail.
- Qualitative: confusing terminology, missing prerequisite docs, unclear error messages, unclear rollback paths.
Template location:
- Google Drive: shared_drives/engineering/private-deployments/customer-pilot-feedback-template (see: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/private-deployments/customer-pilot-feedback-template.json)

Reference runbooks / docs (share with customers)
- Confluence: Day-2 ops overview (backup/restore) – sources/confluence/eng-private-deployments/day-2-ops/backup-restore-overview.json
- Runbook: Create + verify backup – sources/confluence/eng-private-deployments/day-2-ops/runbook-private-backup-create-and-verify.json
- Runbook: Restore in place – sources/confluence/eng-private-deployments/day-2-ops/runbook-private-restore-in-place.json
- Runbook: Restore to new cluster – sources/confluence/eng-private-deployments/day-2-ops/runbook-private-restore-to-new-cluster.json
- Air-gapped constraints – sources/confluence/eng-private-deployments/onprem-packaging/airgapped-backup-and-restore-constraints.json
- Security key-handling guidance – sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/risk-and-exceptions/private-backup-key-handling-guidance.json

Notes / open questions
- Do we require a non-prod environment for pilot #1, or allow production with a limited scope (backup + verify only) for customers without staging?
- For VPC pilots using cross-account KMS: confirm we have a canonical example policy; otherwise pre-review with Security to avoid drill-day failure.
- Decide whether to run PITR as part of pilot #1 or leave for follow-up once WAL archiving is validated in their environment.
acceptance_criteria: Two design partner candidates confirmed with names of operator contacts and a scheduled drill window for each
Prerequisites checklist sent and acknowledged by customer at least 7 days before drill
Internal coverage plan documented (SE lead, SRE on-call coverage, Eng escalation path, Security consult)
Feedback template link shared and agreed; pilot success metrics defined (RTO/RPO targets per customer tier, time-to-complete, pass/fail gates)
Run-of-show includes evidence capture requirements and explicit rollback/abort criteria
comments: 2025-11-13 (Talia Benson): Created ticket as follow-up to PM/SE sync. We need this to be repeatable (template + prereqs) so future pilots don’t become bespoke. Please include an explicit IAM/KMS pre-check step; we’ve had too many last-minute AccessDenied surprises.

2025-11-18 (Markus Klein): Drafted prerequisites checklist + run-of-show. Proposed pilots: Helix (VPC/S3+KMS) and Northbridge (on-prem + restricted networking). Waiting on Northbridge to confirm whether fully air-gapped or ‘no outbound internet but can hit internal S3-compatible’. Will loop in Fatima for on-prem specifics.

2025-11-22 (Rafael Mendes): Add evidence requirements to the run-of-show: start/stop timestamps for each phase, backup artifact ID, restore plan output, smoke test results, and screenshots/exports of dashboards (last successful backup age). Also recommend adding an abort criteria section (e.g., restore validation gate fails, db restore exceeds X min).

2025-12-03 (Marcus Lin): Reminder: do not accept customer KMS material over email/Slack. We can review policies and role ARNs, but no secrets. If customer requests Redwood-assisted access, ensure break-glass role is time-bound and audited (see internal helpdesk pattern).

2025-12-09 (Markus Klein): Helix confirmed drill window 2025-12-12 09:00–12:00 PT (in-place restore in non-prod). Northbridge tentative for week of 12/16, pending internal CAB approval for mounting staging repo.
